name: fleet-manager-client-admission
description: Agent-free fresh-machine proof of installed thin-client admission and explicit forward-generation construction, default publication, withdrawal and runtime removal.
validates: the exact archived candidate prepares through governed dependency admission
a freshly installed wheel's actual console entry point works outside the checkout
explicit client initialization and authenticated selected-release admission persist across processes
same-release retry is idempotent and revoked policy refuses without resetting durable state
admission commands preserve user configuration and create no runtime slot, selector, hosting role or Python network use
explicit generation commands construct and retry a real installed runtime without implicitly initializing missing state
exact reservation and publication bindings support separate default registration, withdrawal and native runtime removal with durable retries
selected runtime removal refuses before retirement and completed cleanup preserves the lineage and admitted floor
missing packaged runtime resources never fall back to a checkout helper

config.CR_HARNESS_MOUNT: directory containing candidate.tar from an exact staged Git tree archive
